correction: In the CI gate's shell reader, a quoted string is 1 argument word and never a command; only the bodies of $(...), backquotes and the string after -c are command lines, and npm scripts are found from those simple commands, each invocation with its own --ignore-scripts
evidence: Re-review of frostyard/core#253 at 3ca376e: commandCalls started a command at each opening quote, so echo "shellcheck is optional" ran shellcheck; npmScripts searched raw text, so echo npm test reached the test script, and 1 --ignore-scripts hid a later npm test's pretest. Fixed in frostyard/core#253 with targeted tests
